purpose: Persistent real-fill journal for Teststock. Reconcile this file from Robinhood order/position/history data before using it for learning.

tradeRecordSchema.journalId: stable unique id derived from Robinhood order ids when possible
tradeRecordSchema.exitReason: STOP | TARGET1 | TARGET2 | TRAILING_PROTECTION | MANUAL | OTHER | UNKNOWN

rules: Robinhood order, fill, position, and account history is authoritative. Never invent missing fills or prices.
Update an existing trade by stable order identifiers instead of creating duplicates.
A trade is resolved only after the live position is closed and Robinhood history confirms the exit.
Use actual average fill prices for realized P&L and realized-R calculations.
Keep modeled Teststock history separate from real-money Robinhood results.
If Robinhood history is incomplete or contradictory, mark fields UNKNOWN and do not use that trade to increase risk.
